audit.whatIsWrong: Four of seven level-chart rows disagreed with the packet AND with the content layer's own whys sitting beside them. win[1] said K'Sante while whys[1] says 'Gragas spikes to 2 off his pool-sustained clear'; win[2] said K'Sante while whys[2] says the trade ends 'evening the level'; win[3] said Skill while whys[3] says 'he edges 4-5'; win[5] said K'Sante while whys[5] says 'his AP spike keeps it even-handed'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Skill, Skill, K'Sante) matches the mirror audit exactly and matches the prose. Gragas's spikes are the level-2 Body Slam and the AP item curve, not a level K'Sante wins.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped as matched full/content pairs with ratings adjusted; the why text on each rewritten to state the mechanism.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (1) 'Q3-knockup' and 'Q3's knock-up-and-pull' appear across both layers. Ntofo Strikes' second stack fires a shockwave that PULLS — there is no knockup on K'Sante's Q at all; the knockback-stun is Path Maker and the wall-knockback is All Out's R. (2) The full layer names Body Slam but gives no cooldown, and never mentions that Body Slam is Gragas's escape as well as his engage — which is the entire reason 'commit while it is down' is the correct rule.
audit.why: Riot's text: K'Sante Q 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.' Gragas E is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s and is his only mobility, so once spent he has no way out of a 450-range Q chain. Drunken Rage (5s) reduces damage received, which is what actually soaks the return trade.
audit.corrected: Pull language corrected in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, whys[2], spikes[1].text and wants.you[0]; Body Slam's per-rank cooldown and dual engage/escape role written into tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and dosFull[0].d; Drunken Rage's damage cut written into dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers and carried a placeholder 'Your committal tool' line.
audit.why: Barrel Roll has a real and unusual property worth stating: the cask arms on the ground and its potency increases over the 4 seconds before it self-detonates, so standing in it gets progressively worse rather than being a flat hit.
audit.corrected: Body Slam by number, Barrel Roll's 4-second ramp written in, and dontsFull[1].d ('Fight in his Q puddle') given the real mechanic.
sources: kit: Gragas Q 'will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time'

notes: The packet's suspectName flag ('All Out's' in late) is a FALSE POSITIVE — All Out is the real name of K'Sante's R transformation and the sentence reads correctly. No change made there. Four chart rows disagreed with both the packet and the content prose directly beneath them and were flipped as matched pairs. The 'Q3-knockup' fabrication that the mirror audit found on Gragas's page is present on this side too, in five strings; corrected in all of them. Barrel Roll is repeatedly called a 'pool'/'puddle' — it is a cask that arms for 4 seconds with ramping potency, not lingering ground; I corrected the one string where it changed the advice and left the cosmetic mentions.
